findings.reason: the done-when as written is unsatisfiable on the arm the read uses, so the §2 node would either fail a passing mechanism or be steered to the fixed-radius representation the ruling removed from the read.
findings.text: §2's done-when requires that the read's per-cell membership, "matching the analytic fraction to within the design document's budget C·(h/R₀)ᵖ ... the measured order asserted to be at least p so an order loss is detected", be satisfied on the read's own output; but the plan's later two-arm acceptance ruling (same snapshot, line 401) fixes the read on the moving floor, where the worst smooth set is first order (0.90 measured), and rules that "the order clause is measured on the fixed-radius arm as the asymptotic statement" while "the amplitude clause is the acceptance for both regions at every rung"; the order ruling (line 386) further relaxes the threshold to "at least 1.9", and the physical-radius ruling (line 395) records the fixed-radius weak order as 1.976 — below the §2 text's "at least p" (=2). A node implementing §2 as written therefore asserts an order the read's own arm cannot reach (0.90) or a threshold (2) its own measured fixed-radius arm (1.976) does not clear.
